data_source.annual_value_policy: current final/restated annual values returned by the API
data_source.deduplication: SECURITY_CODE + REPORT_DATE; latest NOTICE_DATE; deterministic lexical SECUCODE tie-break if needed

modified_jones.financial_firm_exclusion: exclude historical industry names containing bank/securities/insurance/financial terms before peer estimation

main_regression.equation: ABS_DA_(t+1) ~ RRI10 + ABS_DA_(t-1) + Size_t + Leverage_t + ROA_t + SalesGrowth_t + Cash_t + ln(1+nQuestions) + Year FE + Industry FE + InquiryType FE
main_regression.go_gate: main beta<0 and p<0.10 and first-event beta<0
main_regression.no_rescue: Do not alter peer N, outcome, controls, winsorization, or add REM after observing results

governance.tdx_financial_rejected_as_primary_source: fixed_assets exists but no safe stock-code key was identified
governance.hf_hybrid_not_used: unified Eastmoney statements available; avoid cross-source joining
